newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor steady in limited activity.
newsitem.headline: India castor steady in limited activity.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery held steady at 1,142/1,144 rupees per quintal amid limited activity, dealers said on Tuesday.
Volumes remained low due to poor attendance in the trading ring following the riots in Bombay city and its suburbs.
"Trading remained low but sentiment is firm on increased overseas enquiries for castoroil," one operator said.
Groundnut oil rose by 2/3 rupees at 367/368 rupees per 10 kg on shortage of ready stock due to limited inflow while consumer buying pulled prices upward.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil rose by 5 rupees at 580 rupees per 15 kg.
"Arrivals in Bombay remained low as transport operators were not willing to ply after the recent riots," one dealer said.
"We are hardly receiving daily 30/40 tonnes of groundnut oil against normal average of 80/100 tonnes," he said.
Imported palm-oil rose by a rupee at 261/262 rupees per 10 kg on the back of uptrend in the world market but activity in the local market remained slow.
"Palm-oil prices here may come down again as marketmen were expecting fresh arrivals of imported oil in the second half of the current month at Bombay port," one miller said.
